summary: This is an Amendment No. 1 to a prior Form 8-K filed by SmartKem, Inc. to correct the number of warrants issued in a Series A Preferred Stock financing from 23,251,960 to 24,542,982 and to correct the exercise price in the warrant form from $0.6135 to $0.5812. The underlying event is a private placement of convertible preferred stock and warrants, a routine capital-raising transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is present. The filing merely corrects previously reported terms.
